claim: Expansion to six facilities from 10 August is approved, with a monitoring review on 14 September and no change to the prohibition on exporting raw 15-minute series.
evidence: First governance review in the new VERDANT cycle to assess monitoring, security and temporal quality and confirm the conditions for controlled expansion to six facilities planned for 10 August.
Andrés Beltrán: Expansion to six facilities was approved in principle on 31 July. Today we verify whether monitoring, security and temporal quality allow execution on the 10th.
Sergio Vidal: The dashboard is active. Since 13 July, it recorded 27 requests: 25 approved and two rejected for incomplete fields. There were no attempts to export 15-minute data.
Nuria Castaño: The security review closed two minor findings: manual rotation of one secret and excessive permission in a test container. Both are corrected.
Inés Ferrer: Temporal analysis detected six intervals shifted by one hour because of an old time-zone configuration. They were corrected before any transfer, and UTC validations were added.
Carmen Rey: SolCentro activated dynamic suppression and verified temporary codes for the two new facilities.
Bruno Silva: The international partner is ready to receive the expanded hourly dataset and will observe the same signed decision and ninety-day retention.
Javier Ortega: I recommend recording expansion as a scope amendment to the decision, rather than as an unrelated new authorization.
